name: Webb County, TX
findings: Webb County has 299 nonprofit organizations. 98 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 77 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Webb County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Webb County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 92 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Webb County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 106 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 45 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 45 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 4 religious organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.
